OptimumConditions.title: Optimum Conditions for Foliar Treatments
OptimumConditions.subtitle: Ensure maximum efficacy by applying treatments under ideal environmental conditions.

download.desc: Download our comprehensive guide for detailed instructions.

humidity.title: Humidity
humidity.desc1: High humidity slows down droplet evaporation, allowing more time for absorption.
humidity.desc2: Avoid spraying when humidity is very low (<40%) as droplets dry too quickly.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.desc1: Moderate temperatures are ideal for absorption.
temperature.desc2: Avoid spraying above 25°C to prevent rapid evaporation and potential leaf burn.
temperature.desc3: Avoid spraying below 10°C as plant metabolism slows down.

sunlight.title: Sunlight
sunlight.desc: Spray during cloudy days or early morning/late afternoon to avoid rapid drying and UV degradation.

wind.title: Wind
wind.desc: Spray when wind is calm to prevent drift and ensure uniform coverage.

waterTemperature.title: Water Temperature
waterTemperature.desc: Use water at ambient temperature to avoid thermal shock to the plants.

bestTime.title: Best Time to Spray
bestTime.desc: Early morning (after dew dries) or late afternoon are the best times for foliar applications.
